name: GANPI
tagline: A web assistant built on Gemini that generates and explains code.
problem: The team wanted a fast, clean way to get coding help from an AI model.
solution: A Next.js interface over Gemini for code generation, explanations and problem solving, with C++ in the build.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for code and get an explanation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Safe Software Best Modern C++” among 217 submissions.
Won the prize for modern C++, judged on interfaces, safety and performance.

lessons: Language-specific prizes reward code quality more than the idea.
